JADE_GOLEM.name: Jade Golem

VAN_CS2_005.text: Give your hero +2 Attack this turn. Gain 2 Armor.

VAN_DS1_184.text: Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Draw one and discard the others.

VAN_EX1_304.text: [x]Battlecry: Destroy both adjacent minions and gain their Attack and Health.

VAN_EX1_339.text: Copy 2 cards in your opponent's deck and add them to your hand.

VAN_EX1_533.text: Secret: When an enemy attacks your hero, instead it attacks another random character.
